chapters.title: An Eighty-Seven-Year Question
chapters.blurb: Keller asks in 1939: if the Jacobian determinant is a nonzero constant, must the map invert? Eighty-seven years of partial credit follow.

chapters.title: The Determinant That Collapses
chapters.blurb: Three polynomials, eighty-two monomials in the determinant expansion, and all of it collapses to minus two — identically.

chapters.title: Three Points, One Image
chapters.blurb: Three ordinary points, one shared image, checked in exact fractions. Injectivity dies, and the conjecture with it.

chapters.title: The Crushed Surfaces
chapters.blurb: The third coordinate factors, two surfaces are crushed onto one plane, and the map turns out to be an honest three-to-one cover.

chapters.title: The Escape to Infinity
chapters.blurb: Etale but not proper: two sheets flee to infinity across a cubic surface of targets, and Keller's bet finally loses.
